title: Changelog Versions icon design study
status: Design concepts only; active app icons and app code unchanged.
selected_direction: Three stacked folded v marks, receding up-left, with cobalt, tangerine and ivory layers on ink navy.
membership_intent: Alternative app icons are intended to unlock for Supporting Members of the Weekly Thing.

prompts.primary:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: refined PRIMARY iPhone app icon concept for Changelog.
Input image: EDIT TARGET, the selected "Versions" icon. Preserve its identity and design. This is a careful optical refinement, NOT a redesign.
Primary request: Refine this exact icon for small Home Screen sizes. Keep exactly THREE identical folded v-shaped paper ribbons in a diagonal stack receding up-left: cobalt blue rear, tangerine middle, warm ivory front. Keep the recognizable sculptural upper-right curl of each v, the current broad stroke widths, the current lower rounded valleys, same overall shape, same colors, same near-frontal angle. Keep the existing even step between the three versions so all three left arms and all three right curled terminals remain clearly countable.
Only refinement: slightly reduce the WHOLE emblem as a single unit so the group fits inside approximately the central 78 percent of the canvas, optically centered with a balanced 11–12 percent clear outer margin at left and right and ample top and bottom clearance for iOS corner masking. Simplify the fine paper grain and deepest fold shadows very slightly for clarity at 60 pixels. Keep the folds sculptural and elegant. Do not make the strokes thinner. Retain crisp separation between the three layers.
Scene/backdrop: same full bleed deep ink navy #14163A. Matte, subtly tonal, no obvious spotlight.
Palette invariant: rear cobalt #1A4FE0, middle tangerine #FF5A1F, front ivory #FFFBF2.
Constraints: preserve the selected design, exactly three v forms, no circular period, no words, no numbers, no extra glyphs, no book or notebook, no extra shapes, no badges, no borders, no device, no frame or mockup, no watermark. Square image with sharp outer square corners, full bleed navy. Refined minimal premium paper-sculpture icon.
